channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available
item.description: Gemini 4 Carbon, released Nov 10, 2026 for developers, enterprises, scientists and consumers, ranks first on three independent benchmarks including CursorBench 4.0 and has per-task costs over 2x lower than the next-best external model. (Google DeepMind)

item.title: Gilbert + Tobin rethinks the business of law with AI
item.description: Gilbert + Tobin uses ChatGPT Enterprise to build multi-step workflows that reach 87% active usage under human review, freeing lawyers for more human-centered work at the Australian corporate law firm. (OpenAI News)

item.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
item.description: Tether AI Research’s 0.8B-parameter BotPsy, built on Qwen3.5-0.8B for on-device function calling and agentic workflows, outperforms models with up to 1.2B parameters in the blog’s tests. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Experience the art and legacy of Dr. Esther Mahlangu
item.description: Google Arts & Culture has launched the first online retrospective of Dr. Esther Mahlangu for her 91st birthday, gathering more than 45 stories and archives and using AI to recreate her missing pre-1980 childhood memories of Ndebele art. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: GitHub App support for Enterprise Copilot seat management
item.description: Enterprise GitHub Apps can now call enterprise-level Copilot seat management APIs, using a new Enterprise Copilot license management fine-grained permission to control which users and enterprise teams are assigned Copilot seats. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ChatGPT Plus for veterans and servicemembers
item.description: More than 20,000 transitioning servicemembers and veterans have claimed a year of free ChatGPT Plus from OpenAI, while OpenAI Academy has trained nearly 1,000 military community members across 10-plus sessions, with seven more planned by year-end. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon, built for complex coding, agentic and reasoning tasks with a focus on secure code generation, is now generally available in GitHub Copilot under usage-based billing at provider list pricing. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Gemini Intelligence: New features, on more devices
item.description: Gemini Intelligence arrives on Pixel 10 and Motorola Signature 27 with Rambler, which turns dictated speech into text in real time, plus custom widgets and task automation expanding to the UK, India and Japan. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: OpenAI kills old voice mode as GPT-Live takes over—but users aren't buying it
item.description: OpenAI's November 11 announcement that ChatGPT's legacy voice mode retires on December 11, 2026, bets on July's GPT-Live, whose listen-while-answering engine nearly doubled voice usage yet still draws complaints over interruptions, memory lapses and tangents. (AIbase)

item.title: Google Cloud launches Gemini for healthcare.
item.description: Google Cloud’s Gemini for healthcare unifies electronic health records, billing platforms and Medicare datasets while targeting clinicians’ nearly 28-hour weekly documentation burden, with HCA Healthcare among partners previewing record synthesis and prior authorization review workflows. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: C++ language server now auto-configures MSBuild builds
item.description: Microsoft C++ Language Server for GitHub Copilot CLI now bundles its MSBuild compile commands extractor and calls it automatically, so agents skip a separate configuration skill while still getting precise code intelligence for MSBuild projects. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Beijing Internet Court: Platform's mistaken ruling that AI-generated content was unlabeled constitutes a breach of contract
item.description: The Beijing Internet Court ruled a platform breached its contract after hiding user Xiao Tang's post and suspending them for a day over unlabeled AI-generated content, ordering the content restored and backend records deleted. (AIbase)

item.title: Hongguo Short Drama gives AI characters an official ID: virtual personas can now have their rights certified
item.description: On November 9, Hongguo Short Drama Creator Center started registering AI virtual images after creators submit real-person, IP or original-design authorization evidence, generating ownership records that only aid attribution and do not cover content or rights risks. (AIbase)

item.title: Dependabot alerts will pause on inactive repositories
item.description: From December 8, 2026, GitHub will pause Dependabot alerts on most repositories with no activity in the past year, archiving rather than deleting existing alerts, with any push restoring them and resetting the one-year timer. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: We’re bringing Adobe’s creative and productivity tools closer to your everyday Google apps.
item.description: At Adobe MAX, Google and Adobe announced an expanded partnership that lets users edit PDFs directly in Drive and use Adobe AI in Gemini, while Google's frontier AI models head into Adobe apps to reduce app-switching. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: AI models get in on Double 11 too: Zhipu, MiniMax, Alibaba Cloud and others roll out deep-discount promotions
item.description: During Double 11, MiniMax, Qwen Office and Alibaba Cloud are running collective promotions in Tmall's AI Space Station token recharge center, with three MiniMax monthly cards at 50% off and Qwen Office Basic's first month from 30% off. (AIbase)

item.title: How do you keep an auditable record of ownership for AI-drama virtual characters? Hongguo Short Drama rolls out a new rights-confirmation feature
item.description: Hongguo Short Drama Creator Center launched virtual avatar creation and rights-confirmation capabilities for AI short dramas, letting creators submit real-person authorization, upstream IP authorization or copyright registration certificates for platform review and record-keeping, though it is not an absolute guarantee. (AIbase)

item.title: AMD unveils Instinct Coder 355 local coding platform: a single machine that packs in 98% of frontier models
item.description: AMD and Spectro Cloud's Instinct Coder 355 packs 8 MI355X GPUs, dual 64-core EPYC 9575F CPUs, 3TB memory and 63.36TB storage to run GLM-5.3 locally at a claimed 98% of frontier-model performance, serving 85 developers per node. (AIbase)

item.title: openai/codex-security — OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
item.description: @openai/codex-security ships as a CLI and TypeScript SDK that scans repositories inside Codex sessions, saves findings as Markdown reports, and requests patches, requiring Node.js 22.13.0+ or 24/26.x plus Python 3.10+. (GitHub Trending)

item.title: ScroogeFrog AI — AI ad fraud detection that protects your marketing budget
item.description: ScroogeFrog AI's page promising AI ad fraud detection to protect marketing budgets currently displays only a CAPTCHA security check, offering no features, data or case studies. (Product Hunt)
